Installing

If your system warns you about the installer the first time, here's how to continue.

Windows

Run the .msi file. If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, select More info, then Run anyway.

macOS

Open the .dmg file and drag Sanctorum into Applications. If macOS says it can't verify Sanctorum when you first open it, go to System Settings, then Privacy & Security, scroll down to Security, and select Open Anyway.

The macOS version runs on Apple Silicon Macs only.

Debian, Ubuntu and Mint

Open a terminal in the folder you downloaded to, and run:

sudo apt install ./Sanctorum-*-linux-x86_64.deb
Fedora, RHEL and openSUSE

Open a terminal in the folder you downloaded to, and run:

sudo dnf install ./Sanctorum-*-linux-x86_64.rpm

On openSUSE, use sudo zypper install instead.

Help shape the alpha

Sanctorum is still in alpha, so expect rough edges. Bug reports and ideas go to the issue tracker on GitHub, where you'll need a free account. For questions or just to talk, come to Discord.

  • Report a bug Tell us what went wrong and how to make it happen again.
  • Suggest a feature Share an idea for the game.
  • Browse open issues See what's already known and what's being worked on.
  • Join the Discord Talk with other players and the developer.
